```yaml
name: Auto-triage new issues
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  triage-issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Bootstrap labels
        uses: actions-ecosystem/action-add-labels@18f1af5e3544586314bbe15c0273249c770b2daf
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          labels: |
            bug
            feature-request
            priority: high
            priority: medium
            priority: low

      - name: Classify issue type
        id: classify_type
        run: |
          TITLE="${{ github.event.issue.title }}"
          BODY="${{ github.event.issue.body }}"
          ISSUE_CONTENT="$TITLE $BODY"
          
          # Check for bug keywords
          BUG_KEYWORDS="bug error crash broken fix fail wrong regression"
          for keyword in $BUG_KEYWORDS; do
            if echo "$ISSUE_CONTENT" | grep -qi "\b$keyword\b"; then
              echo "type=bug" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              exit 0
            fi
          done
          
          # Check for feature keywords
          FEATURE_KEYWORDS="feat feature enhancement add implement request improve"
          for keyword in $FEATURE_KEYWORDS; do
            if echo "$ISSUE_CONTENT" | grep -qi "\b$keyword\b"; then
              echo "type=feature-request" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              exit 0
            fi
          done
          
          # Default to feature-request if no keywords match
          echo "type=feature-request" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Determine priority
        id: determine_priority
        run: |
          TITLE="${{ github.event.issue.title }}"
          BODY="${{ github.event.issue.body }}"
          ISSUE_CONTENT="$TITLE $BODY"
          
          # Check for high priority keywords
          HIGH_PRIORITY_KEYWORDS="critical urgent blocker blocking severe p0 p1"
          for keyword in $HIGH_PRIORITY_KEYWORDS; do
            if echo "$ISSUE_CONTENT" | grep -qi "\b$keyword\b"; then
              echo "priority=priority: high" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              exit 0
            fi
          done
          
          # Check for low priority keywords
          LOW_PRIORITY_KEYWORDS="minor trivial nice to have low priority p3 p4"
          for keyword in $LOW_PRIORITY_KEYWORDS; do
            if echo "$ISSUE_CONTENT" | grep -qi "\b$keyword\b"; then
              echo "priority=priority: low" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
              exit 0
            fi
          done
          
          # Default to medium priority
          echo "priority=priority: medium" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Apply labels
        uses: actions-ecosystem/action-add-labels@18f1af5e3544586314bbe15c0273249c770b2daf
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          labels: |
            ${{ steps.classify_type.outputs.type }}
            ${{ steps.determine_priority.outputs.priority }}
```
